reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for the car to pull forward out of the dark, a requested behavior, so action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No visual reference exists; the sole supplied reference is an audio engine rumble used as a beat reference, which cannot establish a rendering family, so rendering medium is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference supplies any observed clothing or accessory, and no figure with established attire exists, so wardrobe falls to the request.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference carries illumination authority; the audio beat reference cannot govern light. The dark ambiance implied by the intent stays a request-side description rather than a reference-derived lighting setup.
reasons.framing: No visual reference or observed camera composition exists, so the request governs framing by default; the 16:9 canvas ratio is not itself a camera instruction.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies color or tonal grading; the audio reference cannot govern palette, so palette is request-governed, including the darkness the intent evokes.
